scope: Papers IX-XII finite computational machinery, with separate Euler companion and explicit theoretical/external boundaries

sources.title: Arithmetic Packets, Dyadic Towers, and Local Polynomial Deformation
Euler Congruences: completion, factorial strengthening, and sharp dyadic geometry

mechanisms.summary: Exact residue selection, divided-power convolution, finite inversion, and coefficient transport.
boundaries: Finite supplied coefficient range; infinite analytic convergence is separate.

mechanisms.summary: Finite Mahler reconstruction, differences, affine transfers, kernel composition and prime-power residual sparsity.
boundaries: Finite exact rational/integer prefix; unrestricted infinite analytic extensions are not inferred.

mechanisms.summary: Carmichael unit jumps and simultaneous finite valuation gains, including the dyadic branch.
boundaries: Exact sampled integer unit modes, not arbitrary p-adic functions.

mechanisms.summary: Exact companion jumps, residue recurrence packets, modular orbit search and dyadic-odd factorization.
boundaries: Orbit search and recurrence detection remain bounded; rational matrix arithmetic is distinct from floating-point backend models.

mechanisms.summary: All-address normalized Euler reciprocal coefficients, original coefficient normalization and denominator-clearing checks.
boundaries: Output C[N,j](n) is normalized; original coefficient U[N,j](n)=j!*C[N,j](n); degree N*n differs from packet row n.
Independent all-address recurrence comparisons run through row 16 at widths 1 through 8.

mechanisms.summary: Residual standard-window inverse and common address reduction.
boundaries: Finite modular coefficients and the declared standard-address range, not every integral local-field implementation.

mechanisms.summary: Executable exact packet values and bounded checks of Nishibuchi degree displacements, four-address higher differences, exact displacement valuations and least-period formulas.
boundaries: Finite exact controls do not reprove the inherited universal Lean theorem.
Generic rational stencil checks one declared bound; theorem-level start-index and period rules remain source mathematics.

mechanisms.summary: Odd and dyadic classical signed Euler transfer, inverse reconstruction, row weights and truncation congruences.
boundaries: Classical N=2,j=0 family is separate from congruential width-four packets.
Exact finite arithmetic and declared local congruence; no arbitrary-precision p-adic endpoint object.

mechanisms.summary: Isometric continuation and exact infinite image of four dyadic packets.
boundaries: Finite Mahler polynomials do not construct the complete infinite interpolation or certify its image.

mechanisms.summary: Exact positive-depth prime-field polynomial Jacobian correction, obstruction, torsor, full kernel basis and residue-lift count.
boundaries: Integer coefficients; prime p; positive depth; finite next residue only.
General composite q statement is separately partial.
Enumeration requires max_count; count itself avoids enumeration.

mechanisms.summary: General finite polynomial obstruction over composite residue rings.
boundaries: Smith solves supplied linear congruence systems; automatic polynomial Taylor/residual adapter is implemented only for prime fields.
Prime-field rank-nullity counts cannot be reused over composite q.

mechanisms.summary: Exact simultaneous correction by stacking polynomial equation lists.
boundaries: Finite prime-field existence test; abstract common quotient labels and their universal property are not implemented.
Separate nonempty fibers can have empty intersection.

mechanisms.summary: Choose canonical free digits to construct compatible finite polynomial residue towers.
boundaries: Explicit target_depth and max_steps; later singular obstruction raises.
Finite successful output does not imply an infinite singular path or arbitrary p-adic limit.

mechanisms.summary: P-adic endpoint completion, root uniqueness, coefficient stability, and continuous local parameter charts.
boundaries: No complete p-adic endpoint, topology, local homeomorphism or arbitrary p-adic coefficient type is supplied by finite residue towers.

mechanisms.summary: Exact correction fiber after fixing selected next parameter digits, with solved-block rank and cokernel/count data.
boundaries: Prime fields and a finite next level; fixed_digits refers to next base-p digits, not arbitrary endpoint parameters.
Full-Jacobian surjectivity does not make every prescribed solved-block fiber nonempty.

mechanisms.summary: Weighted nonunit-Jacobian lifting and quantitative coefficient/parameter root motion.
boundaries: No automatic exact inverse-Jacobian valuation certificate or normalized contraction compiler is yet implemented.
The strict r>2s/M>2s hypotheses must not be dropped.

mechanisms.summary: Strict derivatives and analytic implicit root graphs.
boundaries: Uses stated analytic inverse-function inputs and complete local fields; finite numerical nonlinear correction does not implement this theorem.

mechanisms.summary: Singular persistence, presentation invariance, finite compatibility completion and descent.
boundaries: Retain open/conditional source status; one finite obstruction calculation is not a universal solution.

mechanisms.summary: Exact rational signed prime-power mixed stencils and finite valuation controls.
boundaries: Signed convention A(n)=(-1)^n*C(n) matters at odd primes; ordinary first difference is a unit in the zero address.
No compiled universal charged Hurwitz proof object.

mechanisms.summary: Finite exact checks of factorial gains, mixed cancellation class, homogeneous exact families, and address-two power orders.
boundaries: Finite samples are bounded evidence.
Cancellation class can gain more than one bit; no complete deeper-valuation law asserted there.
Source ordinary proofs do not become new Lean certificates through Python tests.

mechanisms.summary: All-rank first-difference families, exact dyadic images, Taylor radii, and the remaining ordinary Euler-tail simplicity problem.
boundaries: Upper-half counterexamples at (16,9),(32,18),(32,19) retained.
Infinite exact radii and tail discriminant/simplicity results are source mathematics; finite coefficient tools do not prove them.

mechanisms.summary: Finite residual partition, lift branches, finite stable cores and companion forests tied to a supplied spine.
boundaries: Only supplied finite levels are represented; neither infinite nonemptiness nor missing residual companions are created.

mechanisms.summary: Exact finite cochain identities, cohomology dimensions and compatible projector decomposition over prime fields.
boundaries: Supplied finite complexes/projectors; not arbitrary Galois cohomology or integral dyadic Maurer-Cartan equations.

mechanisms.summary: Exact rational visibility depths and finite cluster refinement.
boundaries: Finite exact rational coordinates; arbitrary local-field packet realizations are not inferred.

mechanisms.summary: Smooth, weighted and singular finite-chart counts and rational counting series.
boundaries: Declared chart models; counting exponent need not equal dimension/cardinality of infinite compatible branches.

mechanisms.summary: Finite support transport condensation and minimum source-component seeds.
boundaries: Finite directed graphs; admissibility and arithmetic occupancy propagation on edges are inputs.

mechanisms.summary: Exact finite trace-table rank selection, multiplicity recovery and supplied compatible-carrier capacity selection.
boundaries: No automatic arithmetic Chebotarev coverage or universal carrier construction; only supplied separating trace tables.

mechanisms.summary: Supplied finite projector occupancy and numerical finite column-space intersection.
boundaries: Column-space method repaired from unpivoted QR to SVD.
stabilized_at applies only to the final constant run of the supplied prefix; no future-level stability implied.
FiniteHeckePackets is numerical and caller-projector driven; exact joint projector construction is a broader primitive.

mechanisms.summary: Conditional occupied-system completion and separation of residual, higher-depth and global occupancy inputs.
boundaries: Universal companions, local-closure hypotheses and global occupancy remain actual mathematical/external inputs; finite forest data do not supply them.

mechanisms.summary: Actual ideal residue lattice discrepancy and norm-character cancellation attachments.
boundaries: No generic number-field ideal/lattice counting engine in the Python library; retain exact arithmetic witness/external hypotheses from the source.

mechanisms.summary: Numerical finite monodromy chain and nilpotence checks.
boundaries: Latest source uses geometric Frobenius diag(1,q,...), conjugacy scale q^-1.
Existing q argument denotes a general conjugacy scale; pass inverse residue cardinality to match the source.
Exact convention-aware rational constructor is not yet supplied.

mechanisms.summary: Exact tame exponent orbits, regular counts, dual orbit data and numerical Frobenius cycle matrices.
boundaries: Orbit combinatorics exact; matrix roots numerical and existing conjugacy matrix uses inverse Frobenius convention.
Actual local-field induction/type assignment not constructed.

mechanisms.summary: Finite-field cuspidal primitive central projectors and depth-zero reconstruction.
boundaries: Deligne-Lusztig cuspidal character construction, GL_n finite group/type pipeline and compact induction are not implemented.
Generic finite group data are not a substitute for these supplied arithmetic/representation inputs.

mechanisms.summary: Exact norm-lift character exponents, actual simultaneous-translation cycle pairs, rational closing scalars, local polynomials, fixed dimensions and tame Artin conductor.
boundaries: Common prime-power q; regular input orbits; exact nonzero rational closing scalars; explicit dimension/modulus-bit/cardinality caps.
Interaction packets can be reducible and are not asserted irreducible.
Forward orbit cycle closing convention is explicit; actual arithmetic attachment and normalized wild pair factors remain separate.
Independent tensor permutation determinants/ranks and edge-product controls cover q=2,3,4 and all degree pairs1..4.

mechanisms.summary: Exact finite field arithmetic and numerical finite Gauss sums/phases.
boundaries: Fields exact; complex Gauss phases numerical.
Full wild epsilon factors and Hasse-Davenport normalization not automatically certified.

mechanisms.summary: Finite Heisenberg model, central commutator data, alternating form/radical and projective intertwiner envelope.
boundaries: Declared finite algebraic data; matrix phase recovery uses numerical tolerances, not construction of an arbitrary wild arithmetic envelope.

mechanisms.summary: Restricted finite Galois/type symplectic bridge after a declared identification.
boundaries: Finite checks require supplied symplectic/type data and phase normalization; no automatic local-field/type extraction.

mechanisms.summary: Declared phase envelopes and exact dyadic quadratic refinements/Arf data.
boundaries: Alternating form alone does not determine dyadic phase; quadratic refinement required.
No complete canonical beta-extension normalization or odd finite Weil-representation constructor.

mechanisms.summary: Finite matrix transport, holonomy and declared ramification stage assembly.
boundaries: Generic finite gluing is executable; actual ramification groups, increasing breaks and arithmetic attachment are supplied.
Integer break labels and numerical matrix transport do not construct arbitrary actual local fields.

mechanisms.summary: Restricted odd/dyadic arithmetic synthesis and enlarged carrier constructions; remaining general realization and pair-factor comparison.
boundaries: Actual Artin-Schreier fields, arithmetic inducing characters, finite-cover descent, enlarged rank-two/rank-four carriers and exact recovery contracts are not generic Python constructors.
Retain Conjecture 66 and complete pair local-factor comparison as open/conditional.
Do not promote finite envelope or phase checks to a proof of general correspondence.

mechanisms.summary: Completed tensor quotient local-condition construction and continuous point factorization.
boundaries: No general completed Noetherian ring/tensor/topological quotient representation in Python.
Actual representability remains external.

mechanisms.summary: Adequacy and the stated S3 over F7 certificate.
boundaries: Generic finite groups/complexes do not automatically compute group cohomology/adequacy for arbitrary residual images.
Actual automorphy-lifting image hypotheses are external.

mechanisms.summary: General p-group augmentation/coinvariant structure and coefficient-two residual sign example.
boundaries: Only the C2 over F2 diagnostic is directly implemented; general finite group algebra transfer/truncated augmentation/Iwasawa limit absent.
No dyadic adequacy or classicality theorem supplied.

mechanisms.summary: Finite presentation minors, higher Fitting generators, evaluated fibers and point support test.
boundaries: Supplied finite presentation and exact evaluated points; generic prime-spectrum, nilradical and completed support descent are broader than this implementation.

mechanisms.summary: Near-faithfulness, ordinary/derived quotient support and ring comparison transport.
boundaries: Existing reports check supplied booleans/component label sets. They do not construct patched modules, support schemes, tensor quotient rings or derived control maps.
Do not label finite set comparison as a complete scheme-theoretic implementation.

mechanisms.summary: Supplied finite Hecke idempotents and numerical centrality/rank checks.
boundaries: No general canonical multivariate Artin-local decomposition from commuting operators; caller supplies projectors.
Nonsemisimple packets are broader than semisimple eigenvector selection.
Positive-characteristic trace can vanish on a nonzero packet.

mechanisms.summary: Finite numerical intersections and supplied finite set stable cores.
boundaries: Numerical prefix stabilization repaired; no unseen-level guarantee.
Changing vector-space carrier stable-core linear system is not yet a named generic API.

mechanisms.summary: Finite supplied companion forests and empty-level diagnostics.
boundaries: Compatible conjugacy representatives, continuity, integral Frobenius spine reconstruction and arbitrary polynomial quotient survival remain source-theorem constructions.
No missing arithmetic companion produced.

mechanisms.summary: Exact rank-based finite Frobenius trace separator.
boundaries: Requires supplied trace table; no Chebotarev sampling oracle or infinite density evidence.

mechanisms.summary: Explicit conditional five-gate and one-member propagation reports.
boundaries: Caller-supplied truth values retain external assumptions; they do not verify automorphy lifting, classicality, actual nonzero fibers, attached representations or Brauer-Nesbitt/Chebotarev.
Propagation assumes the compatible systems already exist; Conjecture XI66 is not closed.
